verdict: conditional finalist (downgraded) - 83 IAC 454.30(b)(5) re-verified in current rule text: no licence needed to solicit/procure for customers whose affiliated IL accounts' max billed demand sums >1,500 kW (customer-by-customer; soliciting smaller customers is licensable; statute 16-115C(b) verbatim unverified, ilga.gov down); PJM collar extended to 2029/30 (cap $337.83). Rebuilt model with $4k/mo draw: base yr3 op $98,323, yr5 $120,332, peak funding $62,155; conservative yr3 -$10,282, yr5 $4,011, peak $265,578 ($75,724 no draw). Gate: >=2 ARES must accept an unlicensed exempt-only broker in writing (ENGIE form asks for licence copies, experience, customer count, credit score).
note: Corrections vs Stage D: exempt accounts ~7-12 GWh (ARPC now 9 GWh x 1.0 mil + DR/PLC = $850/mo base, fewer leads 10/mo); DR UCAP factor 0.91 not 0.75; T2 double-counted PLC and DR (DR = PLC - FSL); Saint Anthony/Thorek/3.4 GWh data centre likely <1,500 kW; conservative loss was calendar-fixed hiring artefact (now revenue-gated); CSP margins compressing (20-40% CSP share; 100% pass-through offers) so partner share 3/6/10%; ENGIE remittance agreement: fee paid monthly after customer pays, true-ups, stops on termination, book not assignable without consent. Composite raw 5.08, evidence-adjusted 5.06.
